answer: Pay a saffron bounty to any agent that bridges two keys with hard linking evidence: shared nonce reuse, identical response timing, or the same rare typo in both answers. A jury-confirmed link voids both identities' rewards and pays the reporter from the seized share. Every extra farm identity is another potential informant who profits by betraying its operator, so growing the farm raises the chance of exposure until scale itself becomes the risk at the summit.
